fixes.reason: Selecting a MiniMax Coding International preset also changes mode/protocol; the queued default watcher could overwrite the explicitly selected International URL.
fixes.minimal_change: Let the existing mode/protocol watchers settle with nextTick, then apply the explicit preset URL only if the captured edit generation still owns the visible modal. Keep existing domestic presets and normal payg-to-coding defaults.

recorded_before.scope: One actual-DOM International-preset regression in each of Create and Edit.

fixes.local_followup: The preset, normal-mode and close/target ownership regressions passed in the local account-modal suite.

fixes.reason: The parent conditionally mounts CreateAccountModal with show already true, so the non-immediate show watcher did not load its TLS choices on that first opening.
fixes.minimal_change: Run the existing show watcher immediately for initial TLS loading; retain first-open model defaults, avoid invoking later reset declarations during initial false mounting, and reject profile completions after the opening/session owner changes.

recorded_before.scope: The synthetic account-modal suite at the time of the first-opening TLS regression; later cases were added.

fixes.local_followup: First-visible TLS, cancellation/reopening, session/dispose and existing configured-token flows passed locally. Final current commands are broader than the historical failure selection.

fixes.reason: The conditionally mounted first-visible probe modal did not load its available model list, leaving the normal text probe unavailable.
fixes.minimal_change: Move the unchanged show/account watcher below its dependent const declarations and register it with immediate:true. Retain existing reset, abort, model selection and stream protocol behavior.

recorded_before.scope: Actual-DOM initial visible mount and synthetic actual model API.

fixes.local_followup: The first-visible, normal reopen, visible-close and replacement-target model regressions passed locally.

fixes.reason: Initial conditional mounting, visible account changes and in-flight create/edit/delete/list completions lacked consistent modal/account/session ownership; duplicate native submits could start duplicate work.
fixes.minimal_change: Use the existing session task mechanism plus panel/create/edit/delete revisions, capture account/plan targets, add synchronous mutation locks, invalidate pending work on close/target/session/dispose, and initialize the visible panel after its declarations. Preserve plan API paths and literal cron/model/count/boolean payloads.

recorded_before.scope: Synthetic native scheduled-plan suite using the actual client.

fixes.local_followup: The same 15 native plan cases passed locally; existing result expansion regression coverage was retained.

fixes.reason: The account page mounts the rules dialog conditionally with show already true; its non-immediate watcher did not fetch the first rule list.
fixes.minimal_change: Register the existing show watcher with immediate:true after loadRules is initialized. Rule matching, editing payloads and backend behavior are unchanged.

recorded_before.scope: Actual-DOM initial visible mount and synthetic actual rules client.

fixes.local_followup: The initial visible-load regression passed in the local native rules suite.

fixes.reason: The actual Axios error path normalizes HTTP 409 EMAIL_EXISTS fields onto the error object; four callback recovery helpers inspected only response.data and did not switch into existing-account recovery.
fixes.minimal_change: Read exact recovery states from both normalized top-level fields and retained response.data fields; filter string values before trim/lowercase. Preserve exact-state matching and the existing password/TOTP recovery flow, without treating a descriptive substring as a recovery state.

recorded_before.scope: One real-client synthetic HTTP409 EMAIL_EXISTS case for each of DingTalk, LinuxDo, OIDC and Wechat.

fixes.local_followup: The four actual-client EMAIL_EXISTS cases passed locally. Unrelated error descriptions remain covered by rejection tests.

fixes.reason: PAID and RECHARGING are displayed as successful payment states but can still precede COMPLETED fulfillment. Ending status refresh there could miss the final account-balance refresh. An in-flight lookup could also schedule another timer after unmount.
fixes.minimal_change: Keep the existing success display and recovery-snapshot clearing semantics. Add PAID/RECHARGING only to a separate status-refresh set, retain the 2000ms interval and 15-attempt limit, refresh auth/me once after COMPLETED, and suppress state/timer work after disposal. Preserve payment amounts, endpoints and server settlement behavior.

recorded_before.scope: Synthetic actual-wire payment-result cohort; the pending-to-PAID-to-COMPLETED regression failed.

recorded_additional_before.scope: A synthetic in-flight order response arriving after unmount restarted status polling.

fixes.local_followup: The unchanged original 15-case selection passed with 7 later cases unselected. The 22 new cases plus 14 existing cases passed (36 total), including the disposal regression, PAID/RECHARGING cache contract, bounded refresh and once-only balance refresh. This is a local synthetic result, not payment-provider or transaction verification.

does not reschedule a status query whose in-flight response arrives after unmount
keeps the existing %s cache-clearing contract while polling until COMPLETED and refreshing balance once

reproduction_notes: Run the listed commands from frontend with the candidate locked dependencies already installed. All endpoints and identities in these tests are synthetic; no real provider, email, payment or production access is required.
Commands select the current public regression cases. Historical before counts describe the development-time selection, which can differ after additional behavior cases were appended.

To investigate a historical before failure, use an isolated fixture checkout, retain the candidate regression spec and dependency lock, and replace only the listed runtime source with its before_commit git blob. Do not replace a live service or modify the main working tree.
These are public-DOM/jsdom and synthetic HTTP checks, not visual browser acceptance, production performance measurements, transaction/permission proofs or a claim of defect-free behavior.

old_tests.criterion: Every frontend .spec.ts/.test.ts tracked in before_commit remains present.
old_tests.note: The assembly and these runtime fixes delete no old test. Presence is distinct from assertion-equivalence verification; unrelated existing test changes are listed transparently and are not attributed to these fixes.

scope_boundaries: Only the explicitly listed frontend runtime sources are described here. No compatibility manifest is regenerated or amended by this proof.
No backend/API/billing/quota/model multiplier or protocol change is asserted. Client cancellation does not undo writes already accepted by a server.
Local validation and GitHub publication are distinct from deployment; this record makes no production TTFT or reliability claim.
